data_policy_contract_notes: Zero Data Retention is enabled for the configured Phaseo route; Nebius's standard public route may retain or use data by default.
residency_notes: For public model endpoints, processing location depends on the selected model and is shown in the interface; Nebius documents hosting in the EU (including Finland and France), Israel, and the United States. Dedicated endpoint regions are selected during endpoint configuration. Fine-tuning processing locations are fixed and resulting data is stored in the EU.
prompt_training_notes: Zero Data Retention is enabled for the configured Phaseo route, so prompts and outputs are not stored after processing or used for model training. Nebius's standard public route may retain or use data by default.
